snippet.description:
The CEO of Nvidia was exposed for having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. And reportedly, President Donald Trump knew about it. So what are the consequences for national security, trust in AI, and the economy? Vox’s Caitlin Dewey and Sydney Bergan break down the storylines coming out of the controversy. 

Read more in the Today, Explained newsletter: https://www.vox.com/today-explained-newsletter/509593/nvidia-jensen-huang-chinese-spy-affair
